name: hotglue
description_en:
hotglue is an embedded integration platform for software teams shipping customer-facing connections. Customers link their tools through an in-app widget or managed authentication experience; developers configure data flows, transformations and delivery into their product or supported targets.

Its tenant and job model differs from a single company refreshing its own warehouse. Open-source connector support does not establish an open-source license for the complete hosted platform.
description_zh:
hotglue 是面向软件团队的嵌入式集成平台，用于交付客户可用的连接。客户通过应用内组件或托管认证体验连接工具；开发者配置数据流程、转换及向自己产品或受支持目标的交付。

其租户与任务模型有别于单个公司刷新自身仓库。支持开源连接器，并不能证明完整托管平台也采用开源许可。

core_features.explanation_zh: 提供白标弹窗或内联连接组件。

core_features.explanation_zh: 使用需明确部署的 Python 脚本／notebook，租户编辑可产生脚本分支。

core_features.explanation_en: Persist selected state across jobs at tenant scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在租户范围跨任务保存所选状态。

core_features.explanation_en: Track job, discovery and connection events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪任务、发现及连接事件。

en: Embed customer connection onboarding in a SaaS product.
Normalize tenant invoice data with explicit matching keys.
zh: 在 SaaS 产品中嵌入客户连接接入。
用明确匹配键统一租户发票数据。

items.en: Autosaved scripts do not run until deployed.

items.zh: Snapshot／cache 设置可保留客户数据，绝对不存储表述存在未解决冲突。

pricing.billing_basis: Custom active tenant allowance and tier; active means at least one sync job in the last month.

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.en: The widget provides a white-label popup and an inline React connection component. It lets end users link integrations within the host application. That is one part of the delivery: the product team still defines tenant identity, permitted data, mappings and consumption. For an evaluation, use two isolated test tenants and confirm that linking, disconnecting and field mapping affect the intended tenant only. No tenant-isolation test was performed here.
sections.zh: 组件提供白标弹窗及 React 内联连接界面，让终端用户在宿主应用中接入集成。这只是交付的一部分，产品团队仍需定义租户身份、允许数据、映射及消费方式。建议用两个隔离测试租户，确认接入、断开与字段映射只影响目标租户。本次未执行租户隔离测试。

sections.title_en: A native-feeling integration still needs a data contract
sections.title_zh: 原生体验仍需数据契约
sections.en: The documentation describes extracting SaaS data and standardizing it with Python before the backend consumes it. A proposed invoice integration could retain source invoice/customer IDs, normalize currency fields and map results to the host product. If correlating accounting invoices with CRM opportunities, define which keys match and what happens to missing matches. Connector compatibility and a vendor example do not establish that every endpoint, custom field or write-back operation is supported.
sections.zh: 文档描述提取 SaaS 数据，在后端消费前通过 Python 标准化。建议发票集成保留源发票／客户 ID、统一币种字段，并映射到宿主产品。若关联会计发票与 CRM 商机，需明确匹配键及无匹配情况。连接器兼容和厂商示例不能证明每个端点、自定义字段或回写操作均受支持。

sections.title_en: Autosaving is different from deploying a script
sections.title_zh: 自动保存不等于部署脚本
sections.en: Python jobs accept etl.py or etl.ipynb and dependencies declared in requirements.txt. JupyterLab edits must be explicitly deployed; cached autosaved changes are not executed. Launching the editor as a tenant creates a tenant-specific fork, whereas admin editing updates the shared configuration. Test one fixture and the deployed artifact before broad rollout. The documentation’s sample dependency versions are examples, not evidence of the current supported Python runtime.
sections.zh: Python 任务接受 etl.py 或 etl.ipynb，并通过 requirements.txt 声明依赖。JupyterLab 编辑需明确部署，缓存中的自动保存内容不会执行。以租户身份启动编辑器会创建租户专属分支，管理员编辑则更新共享配置。扩大使用前应检查一个固定样例及实际部署产物。文档依赖版本示例不等于当前支持的 Python 运行时。

sections.title_en: Snapshots make data persistence an explicit decision
sections.title_zh: 快照使持久化成为明确选择
sections.en: Snapshots persist files across runs for each tenant and can retain metadata or copies used to detect new/updated records. Job settings say snapshot/cache storage defaults to hotglue infrastructure, with customer S3 as an option. This conflicts with the homepage’s absolute statement that customer data is never stored. Do not adopt that blanket promise. Establish retained fields, location, deletion and failed-job behavior; snapshots normally persist only on successful jobs unless the save-on-failure setting is enabled.
sections.zh: 快照可按租户跨运行保存文件，包含元数据或用于识别新增／更新的副本。Job 设置说明 snapshot／cache 默认存于 hotglue 基础设施，也可选客户 S3。这与首页“从不存储客户数据”的绝对表述冲突，不能采用该概括承诺。应明确保留字段、位置、删除及失败任务行为；默认仅成功任务保存快照，除非启用失败时保存。

sections.title_en: Sync success is only one lifecycle stage
sections.title_zh: 同步成功只是生命周期的一个阶段
sections.en: The lifecycle distinguishes discover, sync, ETL and export failures. SYNC_SUCCESS means extraction succeeded; JOB_COMPLETED follows transformation/export. Webhooks can report job, discovery and connection events, and an optional secret signs payloads. A receiving service should validate signatures and correlate tenant/job IDs before acting. The settings expose automatic rollback on critical failure, but documentation alone does not establish reversal of every external target write. Replay, duplicate effects and callback retry timing remain test requirements.
sections.zh: 生命周期区分发现、同步、ETL 及导出失败。SYNC_SUCCESS 表示提取成功，转换／导出完成后才到 JOB_COMPLETED。Webhook 可报告任务、发现及连接事件，可选密钥签署载荷；接收服务行动前应验证签名并对应租户／任务 ID。设置提供严重失败自动回滚，但仅凭文档不能证明会撤销所有外部目标写入。重放、重复影响及回调重试时间仍需测试。

sections.title_en: Count active tenants rather than simply linked accounts
sections.title_zh: 计算活跃租户，而非仅看已连接账号
sections.en: Pricing defines an active tenant as a customer with at least one sync job in the last month. Basic, Pro and Enterprise have custom amounts and tenant allowances; no public numeric starting fee was established. Pro adds white-label API/callback, observability and on-premise connectors; Enterprise adds SLA, sandbox access and region options. The recommended customer counts are guidance, not published hard limits. Annual plans offer a one-month discount; trial duration requires contact. Confirm performance, storage and private-repository entitlements in the actual offer.
sections.zh: 定价将活跃租户定义为最近一个月运行过至少一个同步任务的客户。Basic、Pro、Enterprise 金额与租户额度均定制，未确认公开数字起价。Pro 增加白标 API／回调、可观测集成及本地连接器，Enterprise 增加 SLA、沙盒及地区选项。推荐客户数量是建议，不是公开硬上限。年付提供一个月折扣，试用期限需联系确认。实际报价仍需明确性能、存储及私有仓库权限。

sections.title_en: Treat connector code and managed service as separate assets
sections.title_zh: 分别看待连接器代码与托管服务
sections.en: hotglue is worth evaluating when a product team wants embedded onboarding and customized per-tenant data processing while retaining a developer-owned integration contract. It is a weaker fit for a team expecting a ready-made business process without coding or maintenance. Singer/open connector compatibility can ease extension, but each repository’s license and version need review; platform redistribution or full self-hosting rights were not established. The old hotglue.xyz URL redirects to hotglue.com, so the original catalog slug is retained under the current domain.
sections.zh: 若产品团队希望嵌入接入体验、定制逐租户数据处理，并由开发者负责集成契约，可评估 hotglue。若期待无需编码维护的现成业务流程，适用性较弱。Singer／开放连接器兼容有助扩展，但每个仓库许可及版本仍需核对；本次未确认平台再分发或完整自托管权利。旧 hotglue.xyz 已跳转 hotglue.com，档案保留原 slug 并使用当前域名。
